top_reviews.title: Very comfortable for walking but I'm not
top_reviews.text: sure if "Nike Women's Air Vapormax Flyknit 3" is worth the price. I've only worn them 6 times so after a couple of months I might up the rating to 5-star.

top_reviews.title: Very light, very... different looking. Too stiff and feels weird when walking
top_reviews.text: My wife only wore these for a few minutes before declaring them oddly large and loose feeling but the sole felt very rigid in most places while making her foot feel a bit strange as she steeped forward, as if it wanted to turn to the side. She felt unstable when wearing them and like the shoe was not meant to be worn.

top_reviews.title: Good but worn, not in new condition
top_reviews.text: I was under the impression that the sneakers were brand new but they most certainly were not!!! You could tell that they’d definitely been worn already as the bottom was dirty!! Disappointed in that regard, I definitely wouldn’t have spent so much if I new they weren’t in new condition!
